notes: Mass: the weighed subassembly total of the sheet (Propulsion). CG: the x of the position sheet, y = 0 and z = 0 are stand-ins.

point_masses.source: 1st Airframe: row 65 Cruise Motor + ally mount (Weighed from unfinished physical item). x: CG Calcs 1 forward tank prop/motor. y = 0, z = 0: not in the sheet (stand-in)
1st Airframe: row 66 Cruise ESC (Weighed from unfinished physical item). x: CG Calcs 1 forward tank prop/esc. y = 0, z = 0: not in the sheet (stand-in)

1st Airframe: row 67 Battery (no source stated). x: CG Calcs 1 forward tank prop/bat. y = 0, z = 0: not in the sheet (stand-in). Battery cage trim: moved +26.6 mm in x to reach the best flight CG with static margin 0.100 (middle of the requirement band) about the neutral point of work/aerosandbox/currawong/neutral_point.json. Flight day: the crew trims the CG with the battery cage
1st Airframe: row 69 Propellor (Weighed the physical item). x: CG Calcs 1 forward tank prop/prop. y = 0, z = 0: not in the sheet (stand-in)

1st Airframe: Propulsion weighed total (row 74) less the mapped parts. Itemised in the rest: Estop, Propellor Mount. Not weighed: none. x: mass-weighted mean of CG Calcs 1 forward tank prop: motor, esc, bat, prop. y = 0, z = 0: not in the sheet (stand-in)
